svg.text: Parallel fibers 12x + 8y = 4k partition ℤ² and project onto 4ℤ
Every lattice point (x, y) ∈ ℤ² is a Bézout certificate for v = 12x + 8y; kernel vector (−2, 3) shifts along a fiber.
Closest parallel fiber to k = 0 is k = 1 (12x + 8y = 4):
All solutions on fiber k = 1 are (1 − 2t, −1 + 3t) for t ∈ ℤ.
Map (x, y) ↦ 12x + 8y collapses each fiber to 4k:
Generator g = 4 is the step between adjacent fibers.
